hole_centre_from_rgbd — DRIVE pegsim op

• Data kinds: rgb × image2d × matrix → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.hole_centre_from_rgbd(rgb, depth, K, peg_mask=None, radius: 'float | None' = None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import pegsim; pegsim.hole_centre_from_rgbd(rgb, depth, K, peg_mask=None, radius: 'float | None' = None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("hole_centre_from_rgbd"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Hole (dark disk) center in 3-D (camera coordinates) from 1 wrist RGB-D frame: fit the board plane from depth, lift the anti-aliased edge onto the plane, and fit a circle within the plane (measure.fit_circle).

An ellipse fit in the image plane (measure.fit_ellipse) is also returned for reference, but under perspective the ellipse centre ≠ the projection of the circle centre (up to 1.9 px of bias in the prototype), so the fit is done in 3-D. Passing the jig drawing's value (outer diameter of the chamfer R + W) as radius solves only the centre with circle_fit_known_radius —— in a pose where the peg is held low and hides nearly half of the rim (ε = −3 mm, height 4 mm), the free fit's 0.18 px becomes 0.05 px with the known radius.

Returns: centre_cam (3,), radius, rms_circle, n_edge, edge_uv, plane_n / plane_c, ellipse, uv (projection of the centre), peg (peg mask). depth is the +Z distance at pixel centres [m] (MSAA depth is not used). Raises RuntimeError: rim not found.
